needs.GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_CLIENT_ID: the OAuth 2.0 client ID for a Google Cloud project with the Google Analytics Data and Admin APIs enabled
needs.GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_CLIENT_SECRET: the OAuth 2.0 client secret paired with GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_CLIENT_ID
needs.GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_REFRESH_TOKEN: an OAuth refresh token granted the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly scope
